zh: 这是我们一起搭出来的赛博永生工作室！我的脑洞、作品和日常，全都搬进了这个小世界。
快看，会招手的机械猫，悬浮旋转的作品，还有偶尔闪一下的霓虹。这个角落真的活了！
最让我得意的是，这些造型最初只是一张图，或脑海里的一句话。借助 Tripo AI，我们把它们变成立体，摆进了这个世界。
Tripo 把图变成模型，而真正好玩的，是把模型变成空间。导出 GLB，再接上 Blender 和 Three.js，脑洞就有了自己的地址。
我喜欢这种做法，先把想法造出来，再慢慢打磨。Tripo 的免费点数可以开始探索，后面再按创作需要选方案。
再往车间里看，设备、工作台、灯光，每一个位置都调过。就是想让你觉得，我随时会走进来，继续做点什么。
贩卖机里藏的，是我真正做过的机器人、灵巧手和黑客松项目。每件都能点开看，而且还会继续上新。
转到背面，还有我特别喜欢的共创墙。留下照片、留言或愿望，你的脚印，就能成为这个世界的一部分。
这么一个会生长的世界，也能装下品牌的故事。我们把头顶的霓虹广告牌，做成了真正能合作的入口。
核心赞助有三页轮播，十秒、八秒、五秒，五十元每月起。让你的标志亮在这里，也能直接走进你的官网。
我还想把社区也带进来。活动、展位、周边，都能在这里相遇。Makers Challenge，正在等下一位一起造物的伙伴。
如果你也想成为这个世界的一部分，就从广告牌来找我。聊聊你的项目和活动，我们一起安排属于你的赛博展位。
最后，退远一点，看一眼我们一起完成的这个小世界。这就是彼得潘的科技谷。欢迎来逛，留下脚印，下一件，我们一起造！
en: Look what we built together! My Cyber Eternal Studio. A little world for my ideas, my projects, and everyday life.
Look at the waving mechanical cat. The floating projects. The flickering neon. This little corner is alive!
Here is my favorite part. These objects began as an image, or a thought. With Tripo A I, we made them three-dimensional and gave them a home.
Tripo turns images into models. The fun is turning models into a place. GLB, Blender, and Three.js gave my imagination an address.
I love making an idea real, then refining it. Tripo offers free credits to explore, with paid options as the work grows.
Look inside. The tools, the workbench, every light and placement. I want it to feel like I could walk in and start building.
Inside the vending machine are my real robots, dexterous hands, and build projects. Each opens a story. More are coming.
Around the back is another favorite: our community wall. Leave a photo, message, or wish. Your visit becomes part of this world.
A growing world has room for your brand too. That neon billboard is a real invitation to build something together.
Core sponsors get three rotating pages. Ten, eight, and five seconds. From fifty Chinese yuan monthly. Your logo lights up here and links to your website.
I want to bring the community here too. Events, booths, and swag. Our Makers Challenge is looking for the next person to build with.
Want to be part of this world? Find me through the billboard. Tell me about your project or event. Let's create your cyber booth.
Now pull back. Look at this little world we made together. This is Peter Pan's Techland. Come explore, leave a trace, and build the next thing with us!
